definitions.gloss: geographical; relating to geography or physical location
definitions.explanation: Pertaining to physical location, terrain, or geographic distribution. Used to describe factors, conditions, or characteristics that are determined by where something is located on the earth.

examples.japanese: {地理的|ちりてき}な{条件|じょうけん}が{厳|きび}しい。
{日本|にほん}は{地理的|ちりてき}に{地震|じしん}が{多|おお}い{国|くに}だ。
examples.english: Geographically, Japan is a country with many earthquakes.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}は{地理的|ちりてき}に{交通|こうつう}の{要所|ようしょ}に{位置|いち}している。
examples.english: Geographically, this town is located at a key transportation junction.

examples.japanese: {地理的|ちりてき}な{距離|きょり}は{近|ちか}いが、{文化|ぶんか}や{言語|げんご}は{大|おお}きく{異|こと}なる。
examples.english: Although the geographical distance is short, the cultures and languages differ greatly.

examples.japanese: この{植物|しょくぶつ}の{分布|ぶんぷ}には{地理的|ちりてき}な{偏|かたよ}りがあり、{南|みなみ}{半球|はんきゅう}にしか{見|み}られない。
examples.english: The distribution of this plant has a geographical bias and is found only in the Southern Hemisphere.

notes:
{地理的|ちりてき} is a na-adjective formed from {地理|ちり} (geography) + {的|てき} (the productive suffix that creates adjectives meaning "-ical / pertaining to"). It means "geographical" — relating to physical location, terrain, or spatial distribution.

CONJUGATION (na-adjective):
- Modifier (before noun): {地理的|ちりてき}な{条件|じょうけん} (geographical conditions)
- Predicate: この{町|まち}は{地理的|ちりてき}だ (rare; usually as adverb or modifier)
- Adverbial: {地理的|ちりてき}に — geographically
- Negative: {地理的|ちりてき}ではない / {地理的|ちりてき}じゃない
- Past: {地理的|ちりてき}だった
- Te-form: {地理的|ちりてき}で

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地理的|ちりてき}{条件|じょうけん}: geographical conditions
- {地理的|ちりてき}{要因|よういん}: geographical factor
- {地理的|ちりてき}な{位置|いち}: geographical location
- {地理的|ちりてき}{距離|きょり}: geographical distance
- {地理的|ちりてき}{特徴|とくちょう}: geographical features
- {地理的|ちりてき}に{近|ちか}い / {遠|とお}い: geographically close / far
- {地理的|ちりてき}に{有利|ゆうり}: geographically advantageous

USAGE:
- The adverbial form {地理的|ちりてき}に is especially common — often paired with {近|ちか}い, {遠|とお}い, {有利|ゆうり}, {不利|ふり}, or {離|はな}れている.
- Use to contrast physical/spatial factors with other dimensions ({歴史的|れきしてき} historical, {政治的|せいじてき} political, {文化的|ぶんかてき} cultural, etc.).

RELATED WORDS:
- {地理|ちり}: geography
- {地形|ちけい}: topography, terrain
- {地域|ちいき}: region, area
- {地政学|ちせいがく}{的|てき}: geopolitical (more narrow, political-strategic sense)
